stories.headline: Odysseus: The man and his monsters in a world in decline
stories.summary: The head of the Vatican’s official newspaper has shared his perspective on filmmaker Christopher Nolan's cinematic adaptation of the ancient epic. Writing for Vatican News, Andrea Monda explores how the legendary journey reflects human struggles against inner and outer adversity within a fading civilization. His reflection invites readers to consider classical themes of heroism and resilience through a modern spiritual lens.
